svg.text: Newton's method closes the gaps between the segments' Taylor paths
y'' = 3/2 y² on [0, 1], y = 4 / (a + x)², 8 lanes a = 1 … 1.875, 5 nodes: each frame is one Newton iterate in double-double
dashed: the exact solution · dots: the node values
The unknowns and the residual's blocks
z holds the left data, every node's fields and the right data; block b matches segment b's path to its target node, blocks 0 and K the end states
a node's color is the segment that starts from it; that segment's block carries the same color
